identificationModule.briefTitle: A Phase III Clinical Study to Compare the Safety and Efficacy of 177Lu-DOTATATE Injection and Long-acting Oxytrexine in Adult Patients With NETs
identificationModule.officialTitle: Compare the Safety and Efficacy of 177Lu-DOTATATE and Octreotide LAR in Unresectable or Metastatic, Progressive, Well-differentiated(G1 and G2) and SSTR-positive Adult GEP-NEN

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The study is to evaluate the sstr antagonists, 68Ga-DOTATATE and 177Lu-DOTATATE,as a pair of diagnostic/therapeuticradiopharmaceuticals(theranostics)in patients with NETS

armGroups.label: 177Lu-DOTATATE Injection
armGroups.description: Subjects in the test group are treated with 177Lu-DOTATATE injection, 7.4GBq±0.74GBq (200mCi±20mCi)/cycle, once every 8 to 12 weeks, 4 times in total.

armGroups.label: Octreotide LAR
armGroups.description: Subjects in the treatment group are treated with 60mg of long-acting octreotide once every 4 weeks±3 days.

interventions.name: 177Lu-DOTATATE injection
interventions.description: The eligible subjects who participate in 177Lu study are randomly assigned 1:1 to either the test group or the control group to receive treatment. Subjects in the test group are treated with 177Lu-DOTATATE injection, 7.4GBq±0.74GBq (200mCi±20mCi)/cycle, once every 8 to 12 weeks, 4 times in total.

interventions.name: Octreotide LAR (Long-acting release)
interventions.description: The eligible subjects who participate in 177Lu study are randomly assigned 1:1 to either the test group or the control group to receive treatment. Subjects in the treatment group are treated with 60mg of long-acting octreotide once every 4 weeks±3 days.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Compare the 18-month PFS rate of NET patients between 177Lu-DOTATATE Injection and long-acting octreotide
primaryOutcomes.description: Compare the 18-month PFS rate of NET patients between 177Lu-DOTATATE Injection and long-acting octreotide
